name: Portugal Current
scope: OSW offshore reference corridor from a selected gate within the 45-50 N North Atlantic/Azores interface region to a selected 35 N Canary feed-region gate. Excludes Portugal Coastal Current, Portugal Coastal Countercurrent, slope undercurrents, Azores eastward jet and downstream Canary route. No whole connected-system length.
layer: Near-surface offshore southward-flow naming context; 2002 drifters had drogues at 15 m. No depth-specific core or full-width footprint reconstructed.
time_convention: Regional circulation geography from an undated repository chapter, 1993-1994 observations published in 2002, and a 2026 regional synthesis. Selected route is not a dated trajectory or annual/seasonal mean axis.
source_locator: Chapter 23 section 2.1, printed p. 880 / PDF page 4: offshore southward Portugal Current from 45-50 N and 10-20 W; coastal circulation described separately.
source_citation: Aristegui et al., Oceanography and fisheries of the Canary current/Iberian region of the eastern North Atlantic, The Sea volume 14, chapter 23. Repository PDF front matter carries copyright 2004; edition publication year not established here.

coordinate_selection: Every vertex is OSW-selected. The northern source-region range gives three bookkeeping gates at 45, 47.5 and 50 N; nominal gate 47.5 N is a convention, not an inferred midpoint axis. Southern 35 N uses combined-system convergence context. Longitudes and bends are editorial, not digitized observations.

scenario_rule: Three northern-interface gate conventions crossed with longitude and independent endpoint latitude offsets -0.05/0/+0.05 degrees: 81 editorial scenarios, not seasonal variation or confidence bounds.
